items: Switching tabs stays smooth while matches load, on every device.
A backup server address added on one device now appears on your others through iCloud.
Family: organisers can delete a family, and failed changes now say why instead of looking saved.

description: Find the match. Fix the stream. Keep watching. Amaviro is a TV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that finds the channel showing your game and sorts out what goes wrong, on the TV service you already pay for.
